decisions.reason: Because this bread was no longer observed after 2019, management would read that as a sign that it did not clearly outperform aspiration levels and would reallocate its easily redeployable core-bakery resources elsewhere.

The sweet pastry fits existing capabilities, but its disappearance from later website observations suggests results or strategic importance fell short of aspiration, making withdrawal the likely boundedly rational choice.

As a farmhouse bread close to the core assortment, it uses established routines and ingredients, and without clear evidence of underperformance the firm would likely continue it while monitoring results against aspiration levels.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship seasonal product with a gold award, so it likely exceeds aspiration levels and strongly reinforces the firm's heritage-based positioning.

The premium Christmas stollen also has a gold award and fits the seasonal specialty business, though it faces a somewhat higher withdrawal risk than the flagship because the firm could concentrate the range if needed.
